name: Kota
description:
Shows how much of your AI subscription limits you have used, right in the top bar: Claude and Codex plan windows (5-hour / weekly), Gemini daily quotas, GitHub Copilot premium requests, Z.ai, and API balances (OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, SiliconFlow, OpenAI/Anthropic).

Percent rings with reset times and run-out forecasts, usage history, running AI agents per project, Quick Settings tile and calendar section. Turkish and English.

IMPORTANT: this extension only displays data. It requires the separately installed `kota` service (D-Bus: io.github.ensignalp.Kota), which talks to the providers. Install it from https://github.com/ensignalp/kota (RPM or `make install`).

Türkçe: AI kullanım limitleri üst panelde. Ayrı kurulan `kota` servisi gerekir.
